item.title: Rupee strengthens in early trade on India–US interim trade pact optimism
item.description: The rupee advanced sharply against the US dollar in early trade on Monday, buoyed by positive sentiment following the announcement of a framework for an interim trade agreement between India and the United States.

item.title: Sensex and Nifty open higher on foreign inflows and India–US trade optimism
item.description: Benchmark equity indices opened firmly higher on Monday, supported by foreign fund inflows, a rally across Asian markets and optimism following a fresh interim trade agreement between India and the United States.

item.title: Meghalaya orders judicial probe into deadly blast at illegal coal mine
item.description: Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad K Sangma on Monday announced a judicial inquiry into a deadly explosion at an illegal coal mine in East Jaintia Hills district that claimed the lives of 27 people.

item.title: Bomb threat emails trigger security alert at Delhi schools and Parliament
item.description: At least 10 schools in the national capital, along with the Parliament complex, received bomb threat emails on Monday, triggering a major security response, officials from the Delhi Fire Services (DFS) said.

item.title: ‘Gunda raj’ in courts unacceptable, CJI says over assault allegation
item.description: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant on Monday condemned “gunda raj” in court premises, saying such incidents show a failure of the rule of law, while responding to a lawyer’s claim of assault inside a Delhi district courtroom.
